items.title: Rudy Mazzari Interview, 1959-11-06
items.q: I can tell you a very successful one in town is Bob Ciccarelli.

ctx.x: Behind the neck and between the second and third fingers. Yeah. It's all in the middle there.

Yeah, and a lot of guys, they just let the thumb stick up, you know, and they, and they just move their fingers up and down. Well, that's a hard way to do it. I mean, they're just making it harder on themselves. But of course, those are the guys who didn't study. They just picked up a bass and they call themselves bass players. Mm-hmm. Of course, they, they may know, some of them know the chords, but most of them don't. Actually, if, if it's, the guy is a good enough, intelligent enough fella who has the, you…
Yeah, I was thinking about him.
